to 110°C for 20 to 40 minutes), the albumin completely gets precipitated.

other substances such as casein, filtering the mixture of milk and ammo-
nium sulphate, and then heating the filtrate.
If milk has not been heated
to 100°C for at least a short time, the albumin remaining in solution win
be revealed by turbidity in the heated filtrate.
